compiled_state.title: RED tests: parallel overlay timing concurrency in ci-llm-review-runner.sh
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Summary
Add RED (failing) tests that verify overlay agents fire concurrently with the tier reviewer in ci-llm-review-runner.sh. These tests must fail before the implementation task makes them pass.

## Testing Mode
RED — new behavior not yet implemented.

## Acceptance Criteria
- GIVEN a diff that triggers both a standard-tier review and a security overlay
  WHEN ci-llm-review-runner.sh executes
  THEN the overlay llm-api-call and the tier llm-api-call are launched concurrently (both running at the same time), verified by mock-sleep timing
- GIVEN mocked tier and overlay calls that each sleep 1s
  WHEN the runner executes
  THEN wall-clock elapsed time is ≤ 2s (bounded by max latency, not sum)
- GIVEN a diff triggering deep tier with overlays
  WHEN the runner executes
  THEN overlay calls run concurrently with the 3-specialist batch, not after arch synthesis
- All existing tests in test-ci-llm-review-runner.sh continue to pass

## Files to Modify
- tests/scripts/test-ci-llm-review-runner.sh (add test_runner_standard_overlays_concurrent, test_runner_deep_overlays_concurrent)
- .test-index (add RED markers for the two new tests)

## Implementation Notes
Use mock curl/llm-api-call with sleep delays. Count concurrent background processes or measure wall-clock time with `date +%s%N` to assert max(tier, overlay) < sum(tier, overlay).

RED markers format in .test-index (space before bracket):
  tests/scripts/test-ci-llm-review-runner.sh [test_runner_standard_overlays_concurrent]
  tests/scripts/test-ci-llm-review-runner.sh [test_runner_deep_overlays_concurrent]
